lines.en: God, I wish Mike were here.
Okay, if Mike were here, what would the two of you be doing?
What are you, animals? It's four o'clock in the afternoon.
- I gotta call him. - Just to talk to him.
I don't need to eat the cake, I'll just smell the icing.
Well, not just a little sliver or...
Okay, just a slice or two.
You know, the next thing you know, you're 210 pounds
and you get wedged in going down the tunnel slide.
- Look, Phoebe, honey, I know this is hard.
But look, if you talk to him, then you're gonna want to see him.
And if you see him, you're gonna want to get back together with him.
And I know that's not what you want.
All right, so give me your phone.
This is your current cell phone.
It reminds me of a simpler time.
- Come on! - You can't have it.
Damn you, Monica Geller, hyphen, Bing!
Why are there men's shoes by the door?
Well, when you get over this breakup, we need to go shopping.
Look, Monica, I really appreciate you checking in on me, but I'm actually feeling a lot better.
I just kind of want to be alone right now.
One billion Chinese people, and they said Mike!
Damn it, Phoebe, how did you even call him?
There's a speakerphone on the base unit.
Look, if I want to see Phoebe, and she wants to see me--
Sorry, I guess I was thrown off by the mention of my name.
Look, guys, you can't do this.
It's just going to make getting over each other that much harder.
Why can't-- why can't we just hang out as friends?
I'm just going to hang out as friends, then-- then maybe I'll join you.
Yeah, I'm your friend, and I'm Mike's friend.
Oh, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa.
I'm going to ask you to get back together, because I know we want different things.
But just to be with you one more night.
I know, I want that, too.
But is that going to make it too hard?
It can't be any harder than this.
I mean, if I had known the last time I saw you would be the last time I--
I would have stopped to memorize your face, the way you moved, everything about you.
If I had known the last time I kissed you would be the last time, I never would have stopped.
If you don't kiss him, then I will.
I asked him to keep me away from you.
Hey, that's what I'm doing for Phoebe.
Well, you're not doing a very good job.
Hey, at least I knew where my guy was.
Yeah, thank God you were here to oversee all the kissing.
If he knew it was going to be the last time he saw her--
